email.body:
Good morning,

Please issue a mid-term policy change endorsement for Coastal Property Management LLC, policy number CPP-2214569, effective 02/15/2026.

Requested changes:
- Add the additional insured location at 2201 S Dale Mabry Hwy, Tampa, FL 33629
- Update the named insured mailing address to reflect the insured’s current office location, if required
- Confirm no change to the current liability limits unless additional underwriting is needed

Please advise if any supplemental information is needed to process the endorsement.

Thank you,
Hector Ramos
Coastal Property Management LLC

provisions: It is agreed that the Schedule of Locations is amended to include the premises at 2201 S Dale Mabry Hwy, Tampa, FL 33629, effective 12:01 A.M. on the change effective date shown in the Schedule.
The Limits of Insurance and all other terms and conditions applicable to the policy are not increased or otherwise altered by this endorsement, except as specifically stated herein.
Any premium adjustment resulting from this change shall be calculated by the Company in accordance with its manual rules and rates and shall be payable by the Named Insured upon invoice.
All other terms and conditions of this policy remain unchanged.
